identity.name: Dusksteel Blade
identity.description: Each affordable normal melee activation costs 2 stamina; damage targets the current enemy. Piercing bypasses that amount of enemy block. Ordinary attacks activate once per round; explicit extra-activation effects may repeat them.
identity.lore: Its maker hammered through the last watch of night.

effects.description: Deal physical damage to the current enemy.
effects.condition: Item is packed and all activation costs are affordable.

effects.description: Bypass this amount of the current enemy block on an attack.
effects.condition: Item is packed and all activation costs are affordable.

conditions: Both unlocked ingredients are packed and form an orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Consume nothing if requirements fail. If the result cannot fit after consumption, it remains unpacked.
recipes.description: Combine two Oathsteel Blade into one Dusksteel Blade.

visual.brief: A long dark steel sword with a split shoulder, forked bronze crossguard and burgundy leather grip. Calm dark blade planes; a deliberate pale fuller.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
